graph_selection: Per panel and model, seed 0 only: highest validation median gene Pearson, then lowest validation MSE, then graph name. No test graph selection.
architecture: One aggregation layer followed by GELU, frozen C1 dropout and a direct output head. MEAN uses row-normalized A+I; GCN uses symmetric D^-1/2(A+I)D^-1/2; SAGE concatenates self features with neighbor-only row means. Aggregation of frozen input embeddings is precomputed, exactly equivalent to one-layer learned linear GCN/mean-GraphSAGE.
capacity: MEAN/GCN match frozen C1 hidden width and parameter count. SAGE width is the nearest integer matching C1 parameter count after accounting for doubled input dimension. No new architecture sweep.
training: Frozen C1 AdamW, learning rate, weight decay, batch size, patience, minimum improvement and max epochs. Primary early stopping uses validation MSE. Three main seeds.
scaling: Use frozen C1 primary feature/target scalers before aggregation. Conditional LOPO uses the existing C1 fold-specific scalers read-only; no new learned scaling or C1 refitting.
controls: S2-50, each selected model, seeds 0/1/2: independently permute graph vertex labels per slide, preserving degree/edge structure but breaking physical proximity. No labels enter graph construction. Train/validation/test all receive deterministic permuted graphs.
lopo: All four panels, three models, seeds 0/1/2 and four evaluation patients. Use primary-selected graphs and fixed rounded median primary best epoch. Compare to frozen C1 LOPO B2 metrics by identical patient/panel/seed. Conditional sensitivity only, not unbiased validation.
contextual_gain: Gene Pearson(model) minus frozen gene Pearson(C1 B2), paired by panel, patient, seed. Also report gains over selected MEAN pooling, MSE/MAE changes, and validation graph sensitivity.
candidate_gene_rule: Freeze descriptive validation shortlist per multi-gene panel and graph model before test access: mean graph-minus-MEAN Pearson >=0.05, all three seed graph-minus-MEAN gains positive, and mean MSE change <=0. Frozen C1 validation per-gene predictions were not stored, so no new C1 inference is performed to create them. Report test/conditional-LOPO gains over frozen C1 local and MEAN for the unchanged shortlist.
prohibitions: No C1 fitting/replay/retuning, new encoder, observed neighboring expression, S3 masks, multiresolution fusion, GAT, explanation or biological interpretation. No C3 execution.
